credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Glass jar containing Terra Verde pigment powder (sea green) affixed with a handwritten label by Georgia O'Keeffe.  Handwritten in black ink, on a faded gummed paper label with a red border, are the words: Terra Verde - Milano. The black metal lid has slight abrasions and scratches and the jar of pigment is 3/4 full.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Addison Doty

title: Paint Pigment, Terra Verde
